systems.finding: TaiXu's canonical S4=P path uses a post-run SkillEvolutionAdvisor to identify a reusable future capability gap or skill defect and propose a create/update action; the human can apply the suggestion through the first-party Chat UI into persistent custom-skill state used by later operation. The reviewed public repository surfaces establish this parent-governed adaptation mechanism, but no published result measures future capability improvement after the adaptation under a recoverable benchmark/model/configuration cell. No direct canonical S4 observation is admitted.
